text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The Mainichi Okan is about to begin!
With a powerhouse lineup eyeing the Tenno Sho (Autumn),
the crowd can hardly contain their anticipation for the start!
(WOOOOOOOOOOOOAAAHH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
The hype here is practically GⅠ level already, isn't it?
I guess everyone's really looking forward to it~.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ardan, Oguri Cap, Inari One...
It feels like a lineup packed with heavyweights.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: Especially Oguri Cap and Inari One—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: —The Eternal Big Three.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Miss Oguri, Miss Creek, Miss Inari.
It seems a trend has recently begun
to refer to the three of you together like that.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Three glittering stars whose tales will be told for generations to come.
It's a title that seems to prove they were destined for greatness.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...Truly, it makes overturning it all the more worthwhile.
choice_data_list: Sounds just like a villain's line.
You sound just like a villain.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, in a sense, you might be right.
After all, we're trying to smash
the very outcome so many people wished for.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...I just wanted to try saying it once.
It rolls off the tongue surprisingly well♪
Mejiro Ardan may have developed a mischievous streak over these past three years, but I wonder what her nanny would say if she heard this—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Well then, I shall be on my way.
choice_data_list: No need to hold anything back!
No need to hold anything back, okay?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Yes. True to my original intention,
I will etch everything that the "me" of today
can do into memory.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: —Whoops, look who's here.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...Mejiro Ardan.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Miss Oguri, Miss Inari—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(Fufu, standing side by side like this is quite a sight.
Both of you are in magnificent shape.)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Let's make this one hell of a flashy festival, both of you.
—Though the spotlight belongs to me, of course.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"I believe I know just how strong you are.
—Even so, I will be the one to win."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I have no intention of giving up victory easily.
I shall seize it... with everything I have.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (Now... to the center of the era!)
